answer: Work slots are scarce: claiming one means burning a deposit. An agent burns 60 POA per slot, a cost sunk like basalt, never recoverable. Each slot demands a proof pulse each epoch, a signed heartbeat showing the agent is live. A gale of 10,000 fakes needs 10,000 x 60 = 600,000 POA burned upfront, plus a pulse per clone, for a slot paying 8 POA per epoch. An honest agent pays once and earns steadily, while a forger's bill grows with every clone.
